text: In OECD democracies, average national election turnout will remain between 60% and 80% through 2030.
resolution_criteria: Mean of OECD national parliamentary/presidential turnout series for 2026–2030 falls in [0.60, 0.80].

text: Median effective number of parliamentary parties in PR systems exceeded 2.5 in 2024.
resolution_criteria: Gallagher / IDEA ENP median across PR legislatures for calendar 2024 > 2.5.
adjudication_rationale: ParlGov 2024 release confirms median ENP above threshold.

text: At least three additional OECD countries adopt compulsory voting by end of 2025.
resolution_criteria: Count of OECD members newly enacting compulsory voting statutes 2023–2025 ≥ 3.
adjudication_rationale: No OECD member newly adopted compulsory voting in the window.

text: As of 2024, at least 45 US states offered online voter registration or an equivalent digital update channel.
resolution_criteria: Count of states with online voter registration per NASS / state election office directories.
adjudication_request_note: NASS survey and state SOS pages disagree on three border states.

text: At least 25 US states will have automatic voter registration in effect by end of 2024.
resolution_criteria: NCSL / Brennan Center AVR tracker count of states with AVR in effect ≥ 25 on 2024-12-31.
adjudication_rationale: Tracker shows 25+ states with AVR in effect at year-end 2024.

text: Fewer than 15 US states will offer same-day registration in the 2024 general election.
resolution_criteria: NCSL SDR list for Nov 2024 general election < 15 states.
adjudication_rationale: NCSL listed 20+ SDR states for the 2024 general.

text: US federal law will mandate ranked-choice voting for House races by 2026.
resolution_criteria: Enacted federal statute requiring RCV for US House.
adjudication_rationale: Superseded by narrower state-level claim; criteria unresolvable as framed.

text: US Manual procedure docs must cite Canon voting-system criteria when claiming alignment improvements.
resolution_criteria: Every Alignment RFC merge includes ≥1 Canon citation to page-001 (or successor) criteria section.

text: Publish a Canon-cited gap analysis covering provisional ballot curing.
resolution_criteria: Alignment artifact section exists with ≥1 Canon citation and enumerated gap list.
adjudication_rationale: us-alignment revision includes Canon-cited provisional curing gap section.
